facts.fact: A National Bank of Rwanda directive issued in January 2026 required domestic interoperable retail payments between banks and electronic money issuers to move to the eKash platform, per ITWeb Africa reporting RSwitch.
facts.system: BNR directive of January 2026 on eKash

facts.fact: Following the central bank's January 2026 directive, from 14 July 2026 all transfers between bank accounts and electronic money issuers (account-to-wallet, wallet-to-account, account-to-account, wallet-to-wallet) are routed through eKash, per RSwitch.
facts.system: BNR directive of January 2026 on eKash
